name: acquire_snapshot_to_first_runs_render_ms
js: (async()=>{const t0=performance.now();[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent==='Acquire snapshot').click();await new Promise((r)=>{const i=setInterval(()=>{ if(document.querySelector('.ck-list button')){clearInterval(i);r()} },20); setTimeout(()=>{clearInterval(i);r()},30000)});return Math.round(performance.now()-t0)})()

name: select_verified_sealed_run_to_timeline_ms
js: (async()=>{const t0=performance.now();document.querySelectorAll('.ck-list button')[0].click();await new Promise((r)=>{const i=setInterval(()=>{ if(document.querySelector('[aria-label="Execution timeline"] li')){clearInterval(i);r()} },20); setTimeout(()=>{clearInterval(i);r()},30000)});return Math.round(performance.now()-t0)})()
